_meta.note: Research-use reference table generated from reviewed master records. Published entries are intended for comparative volumetry only and are not a clinical normative database.
normalization_limits: ROI volumetry does not require spatial normalization to template space when the segmentation pipeline is consistent.
Age, sex, and intracranial-volume effects are incompletely modeled in literature-derived references unless explicitly noted.
Cross-scanner and cross-site shifts can alter measured volumes; use cohort-specific harmonization before clinical deployment.
